<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // Select all "Read more" buttons
    const readMoreBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.read-more-btn');

    readMoreBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            // Use closest() to find the shared container
            // Note: Ensure your HTML containers have a common class (e.g., .content-wrapper)
            const container = this.closest('.content-wrapper');

            if (!container) {
                console.error('Could not find a container with class .content-wrapper for this button.');
                return;
            }

            // Find the specific content element inside THAT container
            const content = container.querySelector('.read-more-content');

            if (!content) {
                console.error('Could not find an element with class .read-more-content inside the container.');
                return;
            }

            // Toggle visibility and text
            if (content.style.display === 'none' || getComputedStyle(content).display === 'none') {
                content.style.display = 'inline'; // Use 'block' if you want the content on a new line
                this.textContent = 'See less ▴';
            } else {
                content.style.display = 'none';
                this.textContent = 'Read more ▾';
            }
        });
    });
});

</script>








<script>
(function(){

  function ensureMainLandmark(){

    const root = document.getElementById("root");

    if(!root) return;

    if(root.querySelector("main,[role='main']")) return;

    const first = Array.from(root.children).find(
      el => el.tagName !== "SCRIPT" && el.tagName !== "STYLE"
    );

    if(first)
      first.setAttribute("role","main");

  }

  window.addEventListener("load",ensureMainLandmark);

})();
</script>
<!-- Auto-update ".updated-by" to today's date. Place in Footer scripts (runs in LightFunnels). -->
<script>
(function () {
  function freshDate() {
    var d = new Date();
    var months = ['January','February','March','April','May','June',
                  'July','August','September','October','November','December'];
    return 'Last updated ' + months[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getDate() + ', ' + d.getFullYear();
  }
  function apply() {
    var text = freshDate();
    var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.updated-by');
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
      var target = nodes[i].querySelector('.wys') || nodes[i];
      if (target.textContent.trim() !== text) target.textContent = text;
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', apply);
  } else {
    apply();
  }
  // Re-run shortly after load in case the block hydrates late
  window.addEventListener('load', function () { setTimeout(apply, 300); });
})();
</script>
